summary: # Command Reference Complete reference for all agent-browser functions. For quick start, see [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md). ## Base Command All commands follow this pattern: ```bash infsh app run agent-browser --function <function> --session <session_id|new> --input '<json>' ``` - `--function`: Function to call (open, snapshot, interact, screenshot, execute, close) - `--session`: Session ID from previous call, or `new` to start fresh - `--input`: JSON input for the function
type: skills
tags: skills-sh, skills-sh-all-time
